gui.skyabyss.trial.abyss.tip: Abyss: trial numbers go above Extreme, +3 materials, and the heart becomes the Heart of the Abyss. Chosen per group (a reborn member picks it; unreborn allies can join)
message.skyabyss.abyss.on: The abyss opens. Trials and the heart go one step deeper
message.skyabyss.abyss.off: The abyss closes. Trials return to their usual depth
message.skyabyss.abyss.locked: Only those reborn %s times can choose the abyss
abyss.skyabyss.title: Heart of the Abyss
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.whale: The whale's beat rings again from the very bottom
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.tide: The shell's tide rises where no light reaches
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.storm: The wing's thunder wakes behind the dark clouds
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.ember: The ember's fire burns black beneath the ash
message.skyabyss.abyss.legend_dupe: The relic you already own turned into resonance shards
item.skyabyss.abyss_greatsword.desc: A greatsword with a bottomless blade. The line it cuts splits again, a moment later
item.skyabyss.abyss_bell_staff.desc: A staff hung with a sunken bell. The ward it rings sinks, then returns
item.skyabyss.abyss_bell_staff.story: "A bell rings best at the bottom of the water."
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_bow.desc: A bow bent at the floor of a thundercloud. Lightning follows to wherever the arrow stops
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_bow.story: "Thunder draws one deep breath before it falls."
item.skyabyss.abyss_ash_scythe.desc: A scythe that reaps ash. The ash it leaves creeps to the next foe
legend.skyabyss.abyss_cleave.effect: The fan you cut splits again 1.2 s later; a delayed blade at x0.6 hits whoever is still inside.
legend.skyabyss.sunk_song.effect: Ward left unbroken sinks into health when the song ends. The most wounded ally also receives half of the total.
legend.skyabyss.sky_fall.effect: 0.8 s after the arrow stops, a pillar of lightning falls there (radius 2.5, x0.9 attack).
legend.skyabyss.creeping_ash.effect: Ash spreads every 2 s to foes within 4 blocks of an ashed foe (up to 3 times).
legend.skyabyss.tide_wall.effect: A wall of tide rises at the end of the rush, pushing foes in front back and slowing them for 3 s (4 ahead, ×0.5 attack).
legend.skyabyss.storm_cleave.effect: Lightning strikes the three nearest foes within the cleave (×0.6 attack).
legend.skyabyss.ember_sweep.effect: The swept ground burns for 3 s, scorching foes each second (radius 3.5, ×0.2, fire).
legend.skyabyss.whale_stomp.effect: 0.8 s later, a ring of stone spikes bursts out and knocks foes upward (radius 5, ×0.7).
legend.skyabyss.tide_hammer.effect: Tide wells up where the hammer lands, healing allies nearby (radius 5, ×0.5 attack).
legend.skyabyss.storm_ash.effect: Lightning gathers in the ash and strikes a foe inside every 2 s (3 times, ×0.5).
legend.skyabyss.storm_bolt.effect: From the foe the bolt hits, lightning leaps to two more nearby (×0.5 spell).
legend.skyabyss.split_ember.effect: The ember orb splits in three where it lands and bursts around it (×0.4 each, fire).
legend.skyabyss.high_tide.effect: 1 s later the tide surges again (7 ahead, ×0.6 spell, knockback).
legend.skyabyss.stone_double.effect: A stone double stays where you blinked from and shatters 1 s later (radius 3, ×0.8).
legend.skyabyss.whale_cage.effect: A whalebone cage rises around the trap, binding foes nearby for 2 s (radius 4, ×0.3).
legend.skyabyss.tide_rain.effect: Foes are drawn into the middle of the rain and badly slowed for 3 s (radius 5).
legend.skyabyss.fire_leap.effect: Fire bursts where you leapt from (radius 3, ×0.7 attack, fire).
legend.skyabyss.tide_veil.effect: Allies in the mist heal a little each second for 4 s (radius 4, ×0.15 attack).
legend.skyabyss.whale_fang.effect: The lunge ends with a ground strike that knocks foes upward (radius 2.5, ×0.6).
legend.skyabyss.storm_mark.effect: A thunder mark stays where you leapt from and strikes 1 s later (radius 2.5, ×0.9).
legend.skyabyss.ember_rend.effect: Cut foes burn for 4 s, and 1 s later the burning wound cuts again (×0.4).
legend.skyabyss.rock_song.effect: Allies in reach of the song gain 5 s of stone ward (less damage taken, radius 6).
legend.skyabyss.storm_curse.effect: 3 s later lightning falls on the marked foe and leaps to two nearby (×0.8, ×0.4).
legend.skyabyss.ember_lamp.effect: Foes around the lamp burn each second for 5 s (radius 4, ×0.2, fire).
